abilities.name: Shocking Orb

evidence.quote: Active: Xerath fires an orb of energy in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and stuns them for 0.75 / 0.9 / 1.05 / 1.2 / 1.35 / 1.5 / 1.65 / 1.8 / 1.95 / 2.1 / 2.25 (based on orb travel distance) seconds.

abilities.name: Eye of Destruction

evidence.quote: Active: Xerath casts down a blast of arcane energy that strikes the target location after 0.528, briefly granting sight of the area and dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

notes: Xerath's location gets revealed to the enemy (400 radius for 4.5 seconds) if Eye of Destruction's cast location is within 100 units of a valid enemy at the start of the cast time due to something related to targeting types.
